new: The output page's panel now sits at the right of the window, so the studio's panel, item list and cards on the left stay usable while it runs.
The Cardinal README says how its standalone app takes MIDI on a Mac or PC: Engine, Enable/Reconnect MIDI opens every port there is, the IAC bus included.
test: Open the output page in the studio's circle and edit an item: its card on the left and the output page on the right should both be usable.
On a narrow window the output page still covers the whole width, as before.
untested: Real MIDI into Cardinal from the output page, the dub-techno scene in a headset.
